intent_contract.text: 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지

Requester meaning is an independently randomized complex image test of the newly integrated water theme using the attached person portrait. The reference supplies visible face and short hair only. The authorial scene is a fictional boatyard worker draining storm rainwater from a supported dinghy. A practical aim connects the retained pool, pumping action, falling stream, impact and already lowered wet line; the viewer should feel the small relief of making a boat usable after rain. The moored-boat alternative was declined because harbor waves would obscure which water is being moved. Clothing, role, circumstances, mood, apparatus, stance and camera are agent-owned open choices, not requester definitions or locks. Subtle sensual support comes from natural face presence, unforced concentration and soft daylight; fetish and surreal treatment are inactive.

A documentary environmental photograph of water in several connected visible forms, organized as one coherent scene with linked causes and results. A person based visually on the supplied portrait is portrayed as a fictional boatyard worker. Use the attached image's visible face and short hairstyle, including the dark chin-length bob and fine parted fringe. She wears a faded ochre canvas work shirt with the cuffs turned back, dark work trousers and rubber boots, with a quietly appealing, natural face and a small look of concentration as she watches the water. At a small shoreline boatyard just after rain, an open varnished wooden dinghy rests firmly on two low cradles beside wet paving. The worker stands outside its near side, both boots planted on the paving and her torso leaning only slightly toward the gunwale. A compact manual bilge pump is fixed to the near gunwale within easy reach. Her right hand presses its short lever downward while her left palm steadies the rim, the two forearms visibly connected to their own shoulders. A clear intake hose curves into the shallow pool at the boat's lowest point, and a separate outlet hose curves over the near side with its open end held above a shallow ground puddle. The water is visibly moving and changing shape: a short falling discharge stream breaks into individual droplets where it strikes the puddle, lifting a low fan of splash and concentric ripples. Inside the dinghy, pale cloud reflections soften over the translucent bilge water while wooden seams remain visible underneath. A darker wet line lies above the remaining pool, leaving freshly exposed wood below it; small beads and thin rivulets cling to the varnished rim. From slightly above the gunwale in a front three-quarter view, the photograph includes her face, both working hands, the visible boat interior, the two hose endpoints and the receiving puddle in a single legible arrangement. Soft clearing daylight gives the water crisp local glints and the face gentle shape. Natural perspective and ample depth of field keep the water connections readable; the distant boats stay subordinate to her practical effort.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Sexual attraction or arousal focused on particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities that carry special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This focus leads the image's appeal and direction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

levels.0: No added surreal treatment; preserve explicitly requested fantasy and impossible elements.
levels.1: Surreal qualities are a subtle supporting presence.
levels.2: Surreal qualities are clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: Surreal qualities lead the image's main impression and direction; a single coherent relationship may carry this prominence.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.

emphasis_resolution.reason: Effective sensual=1, fetish=0; the higher intensity leads.

The worker stands outside its near side, both boots planted on the paving and her torso leaning only slightly toward the gunwale. A compact manual bilge pump is fixed to the near gunwale within easy reach. Her right hand presses its short lever downward while her left palm steadies the rim, the two forearms visibly connected to their own shoulders. A clear intake hose curves into the shallow pool at the boat's lowest point, and a separate outlet hose curves over the near side with its open end held above a shallow ground puddle. The water is visibly moving and changing shape: a short falling discharge stream breaks into individual droplets where it strikes the puddle, lifting a low fan of splash and concentric ripples. Inside the dinghy, pale cloud reflections soften over the translucent bilge water while wooden seams remain visible underneath. A darker wet line lies above the remaining pool, leaving freshly exposed wood below it; small beads and thin rivulets cling to the varnished rim. From slightly above the gunwale in a front three-quarter view, the photograph includes her face, both working hands, the visible boat interior, the two hose endpoints and the receiving puddle in a single legible arrangement. Soft clearing daylight gives the water crisp local glints and the face gentle shape. Natural perspective and ample depth of field keep the water connections readable; the distant boats stay subordinate to her practical effort.
